items.title: Announcing updates to the AWS Well-Architected Framework
items.summary: Updates to the AWS Well-Architected Framework reorganize it into Well-Architected Cloud Foundations and Well-Architected Cloud Workloads, add new best practices, and bring the general availability of the AWS Well-Architected Agent for analyzing workloads and guiding remediation.
items.creator: Haleh Najafzadeh
